A food item which restores energy and applies the deep sleep buff when consumed. It can be made in the [[oven]] or purchased from [[Horadric]].  Higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect. You will need to purchase the [[Recipe tasty and healthy|Tasty and Healthy]] recipe from [[Miss Chain]] to create this meal. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==

On use, a bowl of lentils will apply the deep sleep buff for a duration of 2 minutes. Allowing the player to regenerate more energy points during sleep. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
